highlight.about: Positions to ring, e.g. "s6f5 s5f7" (string 1 high e .. 6 low E, fret 0 open).

pulse.about: Breathe the rings (off under prefers-reduced-motion and `calm`).

calm.about: No motion at all: strings don't vibrate, rings don't breathe.

sound.about: Play real recordings when a position is played (fetches about 0.6 MB on first note).

size.about: A multiple of 640px or any CSS length; unset fills the width.

pressed.about: Held positions ("s6f5") and/or controller buttons (fret1..5; strum plays what is held).

binding.about: Controller button to position, e.g. { fret1: "s6f5" }.
